skill.name: nodemaven-account-api
skill.description: Guides NodeMaven account API requests for traffic statistics, location catalogues, sub-users, and IP whitelists. Explains authentication, pagination, response formats, and credential protection.
skill.summary: Prepare NodeMaven account API requests with endpoint-specific guidance and credential protection.
skill.author: nodemaven

security_audit.summary: All 61 static findings are false positives arising from Markdown formatting, documented API operations, error identifiers, and illustrative network values. Authenticated requests target the documented NodeMaven HTTPS API, and the skill explicitly protects response passwords and discourages redirect following. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, unauthorized reconnaissance, or malicious execution in the reviewed file.

content.user_title: Manage NodeMaven Accounts Through the API
content.value_statement: NodeMaven integrations can fail when clients assume standard date formats, pagination, or response structures. This skill documents endpoint requirements and credential precautions for account automation.
actual_capabilities: Explain the API base URL, authorization header, environment variable, and password redaction requirements.
Guide account balance, traffic, request statistics, and top domain queries with supported date formats.
Identify country, region, city, ISP, and zip code catalogue endpoints and their filters.
Describe sub-user creation, updates, deletion, traffic limits, and usage resets.
Prepare IP whitelist listing, retrieval, upsert, and deletion requests with explicit protocol selection.
Explain endpoint-specific pagination, response envelopes, redirect handling, and common API errors.
limitations: The skill provides documentation and curl examples, not a bundled API client or running service.
Live account operations require a valid NodeMaven API key and network access.
The related SDK and MCP server are referenced but are not included or verified here.
Raw account and sub-user responses can include passwords; callers must extract safe fields before displaying results.

use_cases.title: Review Proxy Consumption
use_cases.description: Prepare account balance and dated statistics requests to investigate traffic usage and frequently accessed domains.

use_cases.title: Build Location Selection
use_cases.description: Use location catalogue filters and pagination guidance to populate country, region, city, ISP, and zip code selectors.

use_cases.title: Maintain Account Access
use_cases.description: Plan sub-user and IP whitelist changes with the required fields and endpoint-specific request methods.

prompt_templates.title: Understand Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain NodeMaven API authentication and how to check traffic left. Use placeholders and identify fields that must never be displayed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner orientation without making live requests.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Traffic Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a NodeMaven traffic statistics request for [proxy username] from [start date] to [end date]. Use environment variables and disable redirects.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request preparation for a specific reporting period.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Location Pagination
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a read-only workflow to retrieve all cities for [country code] and [region code]. Explain filter spelling, pagination, and response validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced catalogue integration with multiple result pages.

prompt_templates.title: Design Controlled Account Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design sub-user and IP whitelist automation for [requirements]. Include endpoint mappings, password redaction, explicit write approval, pagination, and error handling. Do not execute changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced administrative workflow design before implementation.

output_examples.input: Explain why my statistics request fails when I use an ISO date.
output: Statistics dates use day-month-year rather than ISO format.
For October 1 through October 7, 2026, use 01-10-2026 and 07-10-2026.
Supply both dates or a supported period such as today or hours24.

output_examples.input: Review a planned whitelist addition without sending it.
output: Use the whitelist IP upsert endpoint with POST.
Supply the approved IP, port count, and an explicit HTTP or SOCKS5 protocol.
Use the environment-held API key and do not follow redirects.
The documented success status is 201, and the returned identifier is named ip_id.

output_examples.input: Explain how to list sub-users without exposing passwords.
output: Request the sub-user collection with page and per_page parameters.
Read entries from the payload field and continue until an empty page.
Extract only required nonsecret fields before displaying results.
Never print or log the complete response body.

best_practices: Keep the API key in an environment variable and extract only required nonsecret fields from responses.
Disable redirects and validate status codes, response types, filters, and pagination for each endpoint.
Review target identifiers and obtain explicit approval before changing sub-users or IP whitelist entries.
anti_patterns: Printing complete account or sub-user responses that contain proxy passwords.
Assuming every endpoint accepts ISO dates, identical paging parameters, or the same response envelope.
Following redirects with authentication or applying write examples without checking the intended account and target.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live requests still require an available HTTP tool or shell and authorized credentials.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: Send Authorization: x-api-key followed by your key. Store the key in an environment variable; the examples use NODEMAVEN_APIKEY.

faq.question: Does the skill include an SDK or MCP server?
faq.answer: No. It references separate NodeMaven SDK and MCP integrations, but the reviewed package contains only SKILL.md.

faq.question: Can the documented API change my account?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes sub-user and whitelist write endpoints. The referenced MCP server requires NODEMAVEN_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1 for its write tools.

faq.question: Which date format should statistics requests use?
faq.answer: Use dd-mm-yyyy for start and end dates, or a supported period such as today or hours24.

faq.question: Is it safe to display raw API responses?
faq.answer: No. Account and sub-user responses can contain plaintext proxy passwords. Extract required nonsecret fields and avoid logging complete responses.
